req.title: Retrieve player by ID
req.statement: The system shall respond to GET /players/{playerId} with the corresponding player object.

doc.reasoning: The test suite is designed to validate the functionality of retrieving a player by ID through the FastAPI endpoint. It includes tests for positive, negative, and boundary cases to ensure comprehensive coverage. The tests are crafted to be mutation-resilient by asserting exact values, covering both sides of comparisons, and testing boundary conditions.

tests.name: Retrieve existing player by valid ID
preconditions: Player with ID '97da2849-d73e-4b43-8a90-7d090402c802' exists in the database.
expected: Response contains player object with ID '97da2849-d73e-4b43-8a90-7d090402c802'
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app)
response = client.get('/players/97da2849-d73e-4b43-8a90-7d090402c802')
assert response.status_code == 200
assert response.json()['id'] == '97da2849-d73e-4b43-8a90-7d090402c802'
assert response.json()['firstName'] == 'Anjali'

tests.name: Retrieve player by non-existent ID
preconditions: No player with ID '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' exists in the database.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app)
response = client.get('/players/00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
assert response.status_code == 404
